description: Unload one or more loaded servers' tools from this session to free context. The server stays installed and can be reloaded with `mcp_connect_activate`. yaw-mcp also auto-unloads a server after a run of calls to other servers (baseline YAW_MCP_IDLE_THRESHOLD, raised for a server used in bursts).

server.description: The namespace of the server to deactivate

servers.description: Multiple server namespaces to deactivate at once (e.g., ["gh", "slack"])

name: mcp_connect_deactivate
